sales.house: Rago, Object & Home
sales.note: 8 in tall, but lions rather than blossoms; animal subjects usually bring more. Estimate $600-900. Rago lot page shows 'result' with no premium wording; the figure matches hammer plus Rago's buyer's premium, so it is probably premium-inclusive.

suggested.why: Four EBTH sales of 6-9 in staff-decorated Standard Glaze vases dated 1890-1900 ran $325-$1,050, with most between $325 and $525; the $1,050 is an 1890 floral vase almost identical in size and date.

objects.gaps: No Humler & Nolan or Toomey prices: their results sit on LiveAuctioneers behind a login. A DuMouchelle's 1898 Caroline Steinle 7.5 in vase (Feb 2020) exists but its price is locked on lot-art. Also seen: EBTH 2020-08-04 Sarah Toohey 1894 7.5 in brown Standard Glaze vase with a 1 in hairline, $305 (item ITMG598534), not used because of the crack.

suggested.why: Five Rago sales of Tiffany Cypriote vases from 2022-2025 ran $5,016-$7,560; the closest, an 1895-96 L.C.T. 7.5 in example, brought $5,016.

objects.gaps: Only one sale is from the same 1895-1900 L.C.T. period and size; the rest are later or smaller Cypriote pieces. All five are from one house (Rago). Sotheby's (incl. the 2022-2024 Doros Collection sales) hides results behind a login; Christie's could not be searched; Bonhams' Cypriote lots found were 2011-2012 and unsold. Left out as outliers: Rago 2024-07-11 lot 116 (c. 1926, 5.5 in, Rosenberg provenance) $21,420; Rago 2024-07-11 lot 106 (c. 1907-10, 5 in, Rosenberg) $8,190; Rago 2026-03-19 lot 104 'Early and Monumental Damascene Cypriote vase' $61,440.

No Model 127 treadle sale fit cleanly (the EBTH 127s found had cords/motors or were pre-2019).

sales.house: WestLicht (now Leitz) Photographica Auction 33 (Vienna)
sales.note: WITH lens. Condition B+. Estimate EUR 600-700. Just before the 2019 window.

suggested.why: Five Leitz/WestLicht results for chrome Leica III (Mod. F) bodies with a 5cm lens ran EUR 456-1,440 including premium; plain examples sit at EUR 456-1,020.

objects.gaps: Prices are in EUR (Leitz sells in euros); no USD auction result for a chrome III was readable (LiveAuctioneers hides prices, Heritage blocks fetching, Leski is AUD and blocked). Every sale includes a lens; no body-only sale from 2019-2026 was found. A Heritage body-only 1934 III (slow speeds not working) sold for $53 on 2016-10-27 (search snippet only, not recorded). Recent Leitz sales (44-48) mostly offer black/chrome or black/nickel Mod. F bodies, which are pricier variants, not comparable.
